preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge connects two vertices within the valid range [1, n].
The input contains exactly n-1 edges, forming a tree.
The edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree) with n vertices.

postconditions.expression: t == max(depth[leaf] for leaf in leaves)
postconditions.description: The output t is the maximum depth of any leaf from the root (vertex 1).
The output t is a non-negative integer.

invariants.description: The depth of the root vertex (1) is 0.

invariants.expression: all(depth[child] == depth[parent] + 1 for parent, child in tree_adjacency if depth[parent] + 1 == depth[child])
invariants.description: The depth of each child is exactly one more than its parent's depth.
